detail.longDescription: Starting My Data Science Journey 🚀 Hello DEV Community! 👋 I'm Shravan Kumar, a B.Tech Computer Science student and an aspiring Data Scientist. Today, I'm taking another step in my journey of learning and building with technology. What I'm currently learning 📚 Python 🐍 SQL Excel Data Science Machine Learning I'm currently strengthening my Python fundamentals through coding practice and hands-on projects. My goal is to become a skilled Data Scientist by building real-world projects and solving meaningful problems with data. My Learning Goals 🎯 Strengthen Python fundamentals. Improve problem-solving and DSA skills. Learn Statistics and Machine Learning. Build practical Data Science projects. Share my learning journey with the developer community. I'm excited to learn from everyone here, connect with fellow developers, and grow one step at a time. Day 1 of building my Data Science journey.
